OCR: PNG image extraction with OCR enabled. In WASM this exercises the Uint8Array bridge parameter and Promise await in the generated OcrBackend bridge.

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final input = await createExtractInputFromJson(json: '{"bytes":"images/test_hello_world.png","config":{},"filename":"test_hello_world.png","kind":"bytes","mime_type":"image/png"}');
    final config = await createExtractionConfigFromJson(json: '{}');
    final result = await XbergBridge.extract(input, config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].content);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
